WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) as avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS DECIMAL) / CAST(Milliseconds AS DECIMAL)) as avg_byte_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg_rate AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_byte_rate) as overall_avg_rate
  FROM media_type_stats
),
filtered_media_types AS (
  SELECT 
    m.avg_unit_price,
    m.avg_byte_rate,
    (m.avg_byte_rate - o.overall_avg_rate) as rate_excess
  FROM media_type_stats m
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_rate o
  WHERE m.avg_byte_rate > o.overall_avg_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_unit_price) as avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(avg_byte_rate) as avg_of_byte_rates,
  AVG(rate_excess) as avg_rate_excess
FROM filtered_media_types
